generic_name: Pediatric Multivitamin with Fluoride (Vitamins A, C, D, E, B1, B2, B3, B6, B12, and Fluoride)
purpose: This medicine gives your child important vitamins they need to grow healthy and strong. It also contains fluoride, which helps protect your child's teeth from cavities. Doctors prescribe it when children are not getting enough fluoride from their drinking water or diet.
how_it_works: The vitamins in this supplement help your child's body work properly — for example, Vitamin D helps build strong bones, Vitamin C supports the immune system, and B vitamins help give your child energy. The fluoride part works by strengthening the outer layer of your child's teeth, called enamel, making it harder for sugar and bacteria to cause tooth decay. Together, they support your child's overall growth and dental health.
common_side_effects: Most children do not have serious side effects. Some kids may experience mild stomach upset, nausea, or constipation. In rare cases, if too much fluoride is taken over a long time, you might notice white spots or streaks on the teeth, which is called dental fluorosis. Contact your doctor if you notice anything unusual.
warnings: Do not give your child more than the recommended dose — too much fluoride can be harmful. Check if your local water supply already has fluoride added, because your doctor will want to know this before prescribing. Keep this medicine out of reach of children, as an overdose of vitamins and fluoride can be dangerous. Tell your doctor about any other vitamins or supplements your child is already taking to avoid doubling up. This product is not for infants unless specifically directed by a doctor.
typical_dosing: The usual dose depends on your child's age and the fluoride level in your local water. Generally, it is given once a day, often as drops for younger children or a chewable tablet for older children. Always follow your doctor's specific instructions and never give more than prescribed. It can be given with or without food, but giving it with food may help prevent any stomach upset.
